def _check_path(value: Any, expected: pathlib.Path, code: str) -> None:
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or (
        value.get("path") != str(expected) or value.get("canonical") != _norm(expected)
    ):
        raise Deny(code)


def _verify_prepared(
    root: pathlib.Path,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, pathlib.Path], dict[str, Any], str]:
    if not root.is_dir():
        raise Deny("prepared_root_missing")
    _no_reparse(root)
    layout = _layout(root)
    manifest = _read_json(layout["prepared"])
    prepared_sha256 = _sha256(layout["prepared"])
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict) or manifest.get("format") != PREPARED_FORMAT:
        raise Deny("prepared_manifest_format")
    if (
        manifest.get("not_service_registration") is not True
        or manifest.get("not_case_id_or_session") is not True
        or manifest.get("initial_case_empty") is not True
        or manifest.get("expected_head") != EXPECTED_HEAD
    ):
        raise Deny("prepared_manifest_markers")
    if (
        manifest.get("source_pins", {}).get("sha256") != SOURCE_PINS_SHA256
        or manifest.get("source_pins", {}).get("frozen_sha256")
        != SOURCE_PINS_SHA256
        or manifest.get("source_pins", {}).get("bytes") != SOURCE_PINS_BYTES
    ):
        raise Deny("prepared_source_pins")
    if (
        manifest.get("safety_base", {}).get("sha256") != SAFETY_BASE_SHA256
        or manifest.get("safety_base", {}).get("frozen_sha256")
        != SAFETY_BASE_SHA256
        or manifest.get("safety_base", {}).get("bytes") != SAFETY_BASE_BYTES
    ):
        raise Deny("prepared_safety_base")
    if (
        manifest.get("citation")
        != {
            "text": CITATION,
            "material_name": MATERIAL_NAME,
            "unit": "page",
            "from": READ_START,
        }
        or manifest.get("read")
        != {"start": READ_START, "max_chars": READ_MAX_CHARS}
        or manifest.get("input_ready")
        != {
            "names": [FIXTURE.name, PDF_FIXTURE.name],
            "jpeg_control_imported": False,
            "pdf_reference_import_only": True,
        }
    ):
        raise Deny("prepared_pdf_citation")

    path_map = manifest.get("paths")
    if not isinstance(path_map, dict) or set(path_map) != {
        "root",
        "case",
        "ready",
        "appdata",
        "paste",
        "home",
        "system",
        "temp",
    }:
        raise Deny("prepared_paths_shape")
    for name in ("root", "case", "ready", "appdata", "paste", "home", "system", "temp"):
        layout_name = {
            "home": "private_home",
            "system": "private_system",
            "temp": "private_temp",
        }.get(name, name)
        _check_path(path_map[name], layout[layout_name], "prepared_path_" + name)
    if _norm(root) != _norm(layout["root"]):
        raise Deny("prepared_root_not_canonical")
    for key in ("private_home", "appdata", "private_system", "private_temp", "case", "ready"):
        _no_reparse(layout[key])
        if not layout[key].is_dir() or _link(layout[key]):
            raise Deny("prepared_directory_" + key)

    if _settings() != _read_json(layout["settings"]):
        raise Deny("prepared_settings_content")
    if _read_json(layout["daily_marker"]) != {"root": str(layout["case"])}:
        raise Deny("prepared_daily_marker")
    if _fixture_identity(FIXTURE) != manifest["fixture_source"]:
        raise Deny("fixture_source_changed")
    if _fixture_identity(layout["ready"] / FIXTURE.name) != manifest["fixture_copy"]:
        raise Deny("fixture_copy_changed")
    if (
        _pdf_fixture_identity(PDF_FIXTURE, "pdf_fixture_identity")
        != manifest["pdf_source"]
    ):
        raise Deny("pdf_source_changed")
    if (
        _pdf_fixture_identity(
            layout["ready"] / SOURCE_FILE, "pdf_copy_identity"
        )
        != manifest["pdf_copy"]
    ):
        raise Deny("pdf_copy_changed")
    if (
        _source_file_identity(layout["ready"] / SOURCE_FILE)
        != manifest["citation_source"]
    ):
        raise Deny("citation_source_changed")
    source = _source_identity()
    if source != manifest.get("source"):
        raise Deny("source_identity_changed")
    if source.get("entry/server.py", {}).get("sha256") != _sha256(
        pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve()
    ):
        raise Deny("entry_source_identity")
    _assert_root_inventory(root, allow_gui=True)
    if any(os.path.lexists(root / name) for name in RUNTIME_ARTIFACTS):
        raise Deny("runtime_artifact_exists")
    return manifest, layout, source, prepared_sha256


def _append_ndjson(path: pathlib.Path, item: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    with open(path, "a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")


def _checked_file(path: pathlib.Path, limit: int = 1024 * 1024) -> Any:
    _no_reparse(path)
    info = os.lstat(path)
    if (
        not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
        or _link(path)
        or getattr(info, "st_nlink", 0) != 1
        or getattr(info, "st_file_attributes", 0) & SPARSE
        or info.st_size > limit
    ):
        raise Deny("native_file_not_plain_small")
    return _read_json(path)


def _plain_file(path: pathlib.Path, limit: int = DRAFT_LIMIT) -> bytes:
    _no_reparse(path)
    info = os.lstat(path)
    if (
        not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
        or _link(path)
        or getattr(info, "st_nlink", 0) != 1
        or getattr(info, "st_file_attributes", 0) & SPARSE
        or info.st_size != limit
    ):
        if info.st_size > limit:
            raise Deny("native_file_grew")
        raise Deny("native_file_identity")
    with open(path, "rb") as stream:
        return stream.read(limit + 1)


def _single_child(path: pathlib.Path) -> pathlib.Path:
    _no_reparse(path)
    with os.scandir(path) as entries:
        children = list(entries)
    if len(children) != 1:
        raise Deny("native_single_child")
    child = pathlib.Path(children[0].path)
    _no_reparse(child)
    if _link(child) or not child.is_dir():
        raise Deny("native_child_directory")
    return child


def _bootstrap_snapshot(
    layout: dict[str, pathlib.Path],
    case_id: str,
    task_id: str,
    material_id: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    registry = _checked_file(layout["appdata"] / "cases.json", 64 * 1024)
    if not (
        registry.get("v") == 1
        and isinstance(registry.get("cases"), list)
        and len(registry["cases"]) == 1
        and registry["cases"][0].get("case_id") == case_id
        and _norm(registry["cases"][0].get("root", "")) == _norm(layout["case"])
    ):
        raise Deny("native_case_registry")

    index = _checked_file(layout["case"] / "工作区" / "材料" / "index.json")
    if not (
        set(index) == {"v", "case_id", "next_seq", "materials"}
        and index.get("v") == 1
        and index.get("case_id") == case_id
        and isinstance(index.get("materials"), list)
        and len(index["materials"]) == 1
    ):
        raise Deny("native_material_index_shape")
    material = index["materials"][0]
    if not (
        material.get("material_id") == material_id
        and MATERIAL_ID.fullmatch(material_id) is not None
        and material.get("name") == MATERIAL_NAME
        and material.get("type") == "pdf"
        and material.get("status") == "parsed"
        and material.get("unit") == "page"
        and material.get("unit_count") == PDF_EXPECTED_PAGES
        and material.get("pages_need_ocr") == []
        and material.get("is_ocr") == "none"
        and material.get("origin") == "ref"
        and material.get("ref_id") == REF_ID
        and material.get("size") == PDF_FIXTURE_BYTES
        and material.get("sha256") == PDF_FIXTURE_SHA256
        and material.get("rel_path")
        == f"工作区/引用/{REF_ID}/{SOURCE_FILE}"
        and material.get("text_path")
        == f"工作区/材料/文本/工作区/引用/{REF_ID}/{SOURCE_FILE}.md"
    ):
        raise Deny("native_material_identity")
    text_parts = pathlib.PurePosixPath(str(material["text_path"])).parts
    text_path = layout["case"].joinpath(*text_parts)
    if not _within(layout["case"], text_path):
        raise Deny("native_pdf_text_path")
    derived_pages = _pdf_page_text(text_path)
    if not (
        not os.path.lexists(layout["case"] / SOURCE_FILE)
        and not os.path.lexists(
            layout["case"] / "工作区" / "引用" / REF_ID / SOURCE_FILE
        )
    ):
        raise Deny("reference_pdf_copied_into_case")

    refs = _checked_file(layout["case"] / "工作区" / "材料" / "引用.json")
    if not (
        set(refs) == {"v", "refs", "next_seq"}
        and refs.get("v") == 1
        and isinstance(refs.get("refs"), list)
        and len(refs["refs"]) == 1
        and refs["refs"][0].get("ref_id") == REF_ID
        and refs["refs"][0].get("kind") == "file"
        and refs["refs"][0].get("status") == "ok"
        and _norm(refs["refs"][0].get("path", ""))
        == _norm(layout["ready"] / SOURCE_FILE)
    ):
        raise Deny("native_reference_identity")

    task_dir = _single_child(layout["case"] / "工作区" / "任务")
    if task_dir.name != task_id or TASK_ID.fullmatch(task_id) is None:
        raise Deny("native_task_directory")
    with os.scandir(task_dir) as entries:
        names = {entry.name for entry in entries}
    if names != {"task.json", "result.json", "reads.json", "草稿"}:
        raise Deny("native_task_file_set")
    task = _checked_file(task_dir / "task.json")
    result = _checked_file(task_dir / "result.json")
    reads = _checked_file(task_dir / "reads.json")
    if not (
        task.get("task_id") == task_id
        and task.get("case_id") == case_id
        and task.get("session_id") == SESSION_ID
        and task.get("kind") == "agent"
        and task.get("route") == "local"
        and task.get("skill") is None
        and task.get("state") == "finished"
        and "request_id" not in task
        and "request_scope" not in task
    ):
        raise Deny("native_task_identity")
    if not (
        result.get("task_id") == task_id
        and result.get("status") == "cancelled"
        and result.get("usage")
        == {"model_calls": 0, "tool_calls": 2, "elapsed_s": 0}
        and result.get("finished_at") is not None
        and result.get("drafts")
        == [
            {
                "title": DRAFT_TITLE,
                "path": (
                    f"工作区/任务/{task_id}/草稿/{DRAFT_TITLE}-v1.md"
                ),
                "version": 1,
            }
        ]
        and result.get("citation_check", {}).get("passed") is True
        and result.get("citation_check", {}).get("problems") == []
        and isinstance(result.get("citations"), list)
        and len(result["citations"]) == 1
    ):
        raise Deny("native_result_identity")
    citation = result["citations"][0]
    if citation != {
        "material_id": material_id,
        "material_version": material["sha256"],
        "name": MATERIAL_NAME,
        "loc": {"unit": "page", "from": READ_START},
    }:
        raise Deny("native_result_citation")
    if not (
        reads.get("task_id") == task_id
        and isinstance(reads.get("reads"), list)
        and len(reads["reads"]) == 1
    ):
        raise Deny("native_reads_identity")
    read = reads["reads"][0]
    if not (
        read.get("material_id") == material_id
        and read.get("material_version") == material["sha256"]
        and read.get("unit") == "page"
        and read.get("from") == READ_START
        and read.get("to") == READ_START
    ):
        raise Deny("native_read_record")
    coverage = result.get("coverage")
    if coverage != {
        "total": 1,
        "fully_read": [],
        "partially_read": [
            {
                "name": MATERIAL_NAME,
                "read_units": 1,
                "total_units": PDF_EXPECTED_PAGES,
            }
        ],
        "not_read": [],
        "unreadable": [],
    }:
        raise Deny("native_coverage")

    draft_relative = result["drafts"][0]["path"]
    draft_parts = pathlib.PurePosixPath(draft_relative).parts
    if not draft_parts or any(part in {"", ".", ".."} for part in draft_parts):
        raise Deny("native_draft_path")
    draft_path = layout["case"].joinpath(*draft_parts)
    if not _within(layout["case"], draft_path):
        raise Deny("native_draft_path")
    expected = DRAFT_TEXT.encode("utf-8")
    draft = _plain_file(draft_path, len(expected))
    if draft != expected:
        raise Deny("native_draft_text")

    return {
        "case_id": case_id,
        "task_id": task_id,
        "task_state": task["state"],
        "result_status": result["status"],
        "usage": result["usage"],
        "material": {
            "material_id": material_id,
            "name": material["name"],
            "origin": material["origin"],
            "ref_id": material["ref_id"],
            "type": material["type"],
            "unit": material["unit"],
            "unit_count": material["unit_count"],
            "bytes": material["size"],
            "sha256": material["sha256"],
        },
        "reference": {
            "ref_id": REF_ID,
            "path": refs["refs"][0]["path"],
            "kind": refs["refs"][0]["kind"],
            "status": refs["refs"][0]["status"],
        },
        "read_record": read,
        "citation": citation,
        "citation_check": result["citation_check"],
        "coverage": coverage,
        "derived_text": {
            "pages": len(derived_pages),
            "page2_fragments": list(PDF_PAGE2_FRAGMENTS),
            "page2_excludes_first_page_marker": True,
        },
        "draft": {
            "relative_path": draft_relative,
            "text": DRAFT_TEXT,
            "bytes": len(expected),
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest(),
        },
    }


async def _bootstrap_native(
    native,
    root: pathlib.Path,
    layout: dict[str, pathlib.Path],
    host_token: str,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
    started = datetime.now().astimezone()
    calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    ledger = root / "native-calls.ndjson"
    transport = httpx.ASGITransport(app=native)

    async with httpx.AsyncClient(
        transport=transport,
        base_url="http://127.0.0.1",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {host_token}"},
    ) as client:

        async def post(path: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
            t0 = time.monotonic()
            response = await client.post(path, json=payload)
            item = {
                "method": "POST",
                "path": path,
                "status": response.status_code,
                "elapsed_ms": int((time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000),
                "channel": "bootstrap_asgi_inprocess",
            }
            calls.append(item)
            _append_ndjson(ledger, item)
            if response.status_code != 200:
                raise Deny("bootstrap_native_http_" + str(response.status_code))
            body = response.json()
            if not (
                isinstance(body, dict)
                and set(body) == {"ok", "value"}
                and body.get("ok") is True
                and isinstance(body.get("value"), dict)
            ):
                raise Deny("bootstrap_native_response")
            return body["value"]

        async def sequence() -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
            case_value = await post("/api/case/open", {"path": str(layout["case"])})
            case_id = case_value.get("case_id")
            if (
                not isinstance(case_id, str)
                or CASE_ID.fullmatch(case_id) is None
                or case_value.get("created") is not True
            ):
                raise Deny("bootstrap_case_open")

            imported = await post(
                "/api/materials/import",
                {
                    "case_id": case_id,
                    "paths": [str(layout["ready"] / SOURCE_FILE)],
                    "target": None,
                    "unzip": False,
                    "mode": "ref",
                },
            )
            registered = imported.get("registered")
            if not (
                imported.get("copied") == []
                and imported.get("skipped") == []
                and isinstance(registered, list)
                and len(registered) == 1
                and registered[0].get("ref_id") == REF_ID
                and registered[0].get("kind") == "file"
                and _norm(registered[0].get("path", ""))
                == _norm(layout["ready"] / SOURCE_FILE)
            ):
                raise Deny("bootstrap_reference_import")

            index = _checked_file(layout["case"] / "工作区" / "材料" / "index.json")
            if not (
                isinstance(index.get("materials"), list)
                and len(index["materials"]) == 1
                and MATERIAL_ID.fullmatch(
                    str(index["materials"][0].get("material_id"))
                )
            ):
                raise Deny("bootstrap_material_index")
            material_id = index["materials"][0]["material_id"]

            begin = await post(
                "/core/task/begin",
                {"session_id": SESSION_ID, "cwd": str(layout["case"])},
            )
            task_id = begin.get("task_id")
            if not (
                isinstance(task_id, str)
                and TASK_ID.fullmatch(task_id) is not None
                and begin.get("case_id") == case_id
                and begin.get("route") == "local"
                and begin.get("skill") is None
            ):
                raise Deny("bootstrap_task_begin")

            read = await post(
                "/core/tool",
                {
                    "task_id": task_id,
                    "tool": "case_read_material",
                    "args": {
                        "name": MATERIAL_NAME,
                        "start": READ_START,
                        "max_chars": READ_MAX_CHARS,
                    },
                },
            )
            if not (
                read.get("material_id") == material_id
                and read.get("name") == MATERIAL_NAME
                and read.get("unit") == "page"
                and read.get("start") == READ_START
                and read.get("end") == READ_START
                and isinstance(read.get("text"), str)
                and read["text"].startswith(f"【第{READ_START}页】\n")
                and all(
                    fragment in read["text"] for fragment in PDF_PAGE2_FRAGMENTS
                )
                and PDF_FIRST_PAGE_MARKER not in read["text"]
                and read.get("has_more") is True
                and read.get("next_start") == READ_START + 1
                and read.get("next_offset") is None
            ):
                raise Deny("bootstrap_read_material")

            saved = await post(
                "/core/tool",
                {
                    "task_id": task_id,
                    "tool": "case_save_draft",
                    "args": {"title": DRAFT_TITLE, "content": DRAFT_TEXT},
                },
            )
            expected_relative = (
                f"工作区/任务/{task_id}/草稿/{DRAFT_TITLE}-v1.md"
            )
            if not (
                saved.get("path") == expected_relative
                and saved.get("version") == 1
                and saved.get("citation_check", {}).get("passed") is True
                and saved.get("not_fully_read") == [MATERIAL_NAME]
                and saved.get("coverage")
                == {
                    "total": 1,
                    "fully_read": [],
                    "partially_read": [
                        {
                            "name": MATERIAL_NAME,
                            "read_units": 1,
                            "total_units": PDF_EXPECTED_PAGES,
                        }
                    ],
                    "not_read": [],
                    "unreadable": [],
                }
            ):
                raise Deny("bootstrap_save_draft")

            ended = await post(
                "/core/task/end",
                {
                    "task_id": task_id,
                    "reason": "aborted",
                    "model_calls": 0,
                    "tool_calls": 2,
                    "elapsed_s": 0,
                },
            )
            if ended != {"status": "cancelled"}:
                raise Deny("bootstrap_task_end")
            return {"case_id": case_id, "task_id": task_id, "material_id": material_id}, {
                "read": read,
                "saved": saved,
                "ended": ended,
            }

        ids, values = await asyncio.wait_for(sequence(), timeout=20)

    if len(calls) != 6:
        raise Deny("bootstrap_native_call_count")
    snap = _bootstrap_snapshot(
        layout, ids["case_id"], ids["task_id"], ids["material_id"]
    )
    if not (
        snap["read_record"]["material_id"] == values["read"]["material_id"]
        and snap["read_record"]["unit"] == values["read"]["unit"]
        and snap["read_record"]["from"] == values["read"]["start"]
        and snap["read_record"]["to"] == values["read"]["end"]
    ):
        raise Deny("bootstrap_read_snapshot")
    if not (
        snap["draft"]["relative_path"] == values["saved"]["path"]
        and snap["citation_check"] == values["saved"]["citation_check"]

def _query_pairs(query: bytes, *, require: set[str], optional: set[str] = frozenset()):
    if not query or len(query) > 4096:
        return None
    try:
        pairs = parse_qsl(
            query.decode("utf-8"),
            keep_blank_values=True,
            strict_parsing=True,
            max_num_fields=12,
        )
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError):
        return None
    if any(not value for _key, value in pairs):
        return None
    keys = [key for key, _value in pairs]
    if len(keys) != len(set(keys)):
        return None
    if not require.issubset(keys) or not set(keys).issubset(require | optional):
        return None
    return dict(pairs)


class Firewall:
    def __init__(
        self,
        app,
        *,
        layout: dict[str, pathlib.Path],
        report: dict[str, Any],
        host_token: str,
    ) -> None:
        self.app = app
        self.case = layout["case"]
        self.case_id = report["case_id"]
        self.task_id = report["task_id"]
        self.material_id = report["material"]["material_id"]
        self.material_name = report["material"]["name"]
        self.citation = CITATION
        self.expected_auth = ("Bearer " + host_token).encode("utf-8")
        self.registry = layout["appdata"] / "cases.json"
        self.ledger = layout["root"] / "requests.ndjson"
        self.lock = threading.RLock()
        self.records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.failure_code: str | None = None
        self.source_claimed = False
        self.source_complete = False
        self.source_png: dict[str, int] | None = None
        self.case_open_attempts = 0
        self.case_open_ok = 0
        self.auth_denials = 0
        self.policy_denials: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.read_ok = 0
        with open(self.ledger, "x", encoding="utf-8"):
            pass

    def _record(
        self,
        method: str,
        path: str,
        status: int | None,
        disposition: str,
        started: float,
    ) -> None:
        item = {
            "method": method,
            "path": path,
            "status": status,
            "disposition": disposition,
            "channel": "tcp_loopback",
            "elapsed_ms": int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000),
        }
        with self.lock:
            if self.failure_code is not None:
                item["protocol_failure"] = self.failure_code
            self.records.append(item)
            _append_ndjson(self.ledger, item)

    def _deny(self, code: str) -> None:
        with self.lock:
            self.policy_denials[code] = self.policy_denials.get(code, 0) + 1

    def _fail(self, code: str) -> None:
        with self.lock:
            self.failure_code = self.failure_code or code

    def _authorized(self, scope) -> bool:
        values = [
            value
            for key, value in scope.get("headers", [])
            if key.lower() == b"authorization"
        ]
        if len(values) != 1 or not hmac.compare_digest(values[0], self.expected_auth):
            with self.lock:
                self.auth_denials += 1
            return False
        return True

    def _own_registry(self) -> bool:
        try:
            data = _checked_file(self.registry, 64 * 1024)
            cases = data.get("cases") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
            return (
                isinstance(data, dict)
                and data.get("v") == 1
                and isinstance(cases, list)
                and len(cases) == 1
                and cases[0].get("case_id") == self.case_id
                and _norm(cases[0].get("root", "")) == _norm(self.case)
            )
        except (Deny, OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
            return False

    def _source_authority(self) -> bool:
        try:
            task_dir = _single_child(self.case / "工作区" / "任务")
            if task_dir.name != self.task_id:
                return False
            result = _checked_file(task_dir / "result.json")
            index = _checked_file(self.case / "工作区" / "材料" / "index.json")
            material = next(
                (
                    item
                    for item in index.get("materials", [])
                    if item.get("material_id") == self.material_id
                ),
                None,
            )
            return bool(
                result.get("task_id") == self.task_id
                and isinstance(result.get("citations"), list)
                and len(result["citations"]) == 1
                and result["citations"][0].get("material_id") == self.material_id
                and result["citations"][0].get("name") == self.material_name
                and result["citations"][0].get("loc")
                == {"unit": "page", "from": READ_START}
                and material is not None
                and material.get("name") == self.material_name
                and material.get("origin") == "ref"
            )
        except (Deny, OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
            return False

    def _case_query(self, path: str, query: bytes) -> str | None:
        values = _query_pairs(query, require={"case_id"})
        if values is None:
            return "CASE_QUERY_EXACT"
        if values["case_id"] != self.case_id:
            return "CASE_ID_OUTSIDE_RUN"
        return None

    def _source_query(self, query: bytes) -> str | None:
        values = _query_pairs(
            query,
            require={"case_id", "material_id", "citation", "task_id"},
        )
        if values is None:
            return "SOURCE_QUERY_EXACT"
        if values["case_id"] != self.case_id:
            return "SOURCE_CASE_ID"
        if values["material_id"] != self.material_id:
            return "SOURCE_MATERIAL_ID"
        if values["citation"] != self.citation:
            return "SOURCE_CITATION"
        if values["task_id"] != self.task_id:
            return "SOURCE_TASK_ID"
        if not self._own_registry():
            return "SOURCE_CASE_REGISTRY"
        if not self._source_authority():
            return "SOURCE_AUTHORITY"
        with self.lock:
            if self.source_claimed or self.source_complete:
                return "SOURCE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"
            self.source_claimed = True
        return None

    def _claim_case(self, data: Any, query: bytes) -> str | None:
        if query:
            return "CASE_OPEN_QUERY"
        if not (
            isinstance(data, dict)
            and set(data) == {"path", "template"}
            and data.get("template") is None
            and isinstance(data.get("path"), str)
        ):
            return "CASE_OPEN_BODY"
        if _norm(data["path"]) != _norm(self.case):
            return "CASE_OPEN_PATH"
        with self.lock:
            if self.case_open_attempts >= 4:
                return "CASE_OPEN_LIMIT"
            self.case_open_attempts += 1
        return None

    def _policy(
        self,
        method: str,
        path: str,
        data: Any,
        query: bytes,
    ) -> str | None:
        if (method, path) not in ROUTES:
            return "ROUTE_OR_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED"
        if not self._own_registry():
            return "CASE_REGISTRY"
        if method == "POST":
            return self._claim_case(data, query)
        if path in NO_QUERY_ROUTES:
            return None if not query else "UNEXPECTED_QUERY"
        if path == "/api/task/current":
            values = _query_pairs(query, require={"session_id"})
            if values is None:
                return "SESSION_ID_QUERY_REQUIRED"
            if len(values["session_id"]) > 128:
                return "SESSION_ID_LENGTH"
            return None
        if path in CASE_QUERY_ROUTES:
            return self._case_query(path, query)
        if path == "/api/source":
            return self._source_query(query)
        return "ROUTE_NOT_ALLOWED"

    def _complete_case(self, status: int | None, response: Any) -> None:
        value = response.get("value") if isinstance(response, dict) else None
        if not (
            status == 200
            and isinstance(response, dict)
            and set(response) == {"ok", "value"}
            and response.get("ok") is True
            and isinstance(value, dict)
            and value.get("case_id") == self.case_id
            and value.get("created") is False
        ):
            self._fail("CASE_OPEN_RESPONSE")
            return
        with self.lock:
            self.case_open_ok += 1

    def _complete_source(self, status: int | None, response: Any) -> None:
        value = response.get("value") if isinstance(response, dict) else None
        if not (
            status == 200
            and isinstance(response, dict)
            and set(response) == {"ok", "value"}
            and response.get("ok") is True
            and isinstance(value, dict)
            and value.get("name") == self.material_name
            and value.get("loc") == {"unit": "page", "from": READ_START}
            and isinstance(value.get("text"), str)
            and all(fragment in value["text"] for fragment in PDF_PAGE2_FRAGMENTS)
            and PDF_FIRST_PAGE_MARKER not in value["text"]
            and value.get("source_changed") is False
            and value.get("original_status") == "ok"
        ):
            self._fail("SOURCE_RESPONSE")
            return
        try:
            png = _png_identity(value.get("page_png_base64"))
        except Deny as exc:
            self._fail(exc.code)
            return
        with self.lock:
            self.source_png = png
            self.source_complete = True

    def _complete_read(self, path: str, status: int | None, response: Any) -> None:
        if path == "/health":
            if not (
                status == 200
                and response == {"status": "ok", "contract_version": "1.6"}
            ):
                self._fail("HEALTH_RESPONSE")
            return
        if not (
            status == 200
            and isinstance(response, dict)
            and set(response) == {"ok", "value"}
            and response.get("ok") is True
        ):
            self._fail("READ_RESPONSE")
            return
        with self.lock:
            self.read_ok += 1

    async def __call__(self, scope, receive, send) -> None:
        if scope["type"] != "http":
            return
        method, path, started = scope["method"], scope["path"], time.monotonic()
        if not self._authorized(scope):
            self._record(method, path, 401, "auth_not_forwarded", started)
            await _guard_reply(send, 401, "AUTH_REQUIRED")
            return
        if (method, path) not in ROUTES:
            self._deny("ROUTE_OR_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED")
            self._record(
                method, path, 403, "ROUTE_OR_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", started
            )
            await _guard_reply(send, 403, "ROUTE_OR_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED")
            return

        body, data = b"", None
        if method == "POST":
            original = receive
            try:
                body = await _read_body(receive)
            except Deny:
                self._deny("BODY_TOO_LARGE")
                self._record(method, path, 413, "BODY_TOO_LARGE", started)
                await _guard_reply(send, 413, "BODY_TOO_LARGE")
                return
            if body is None:
                self._record(method, path, None, "disconnected", started)
                return
            data = _json(body)
            used = False

            async def replay():
                nonlocal used
                if not used:
                    used = True
                    return {"type": "http.request", "body": body, "more_body": False}
                return await original()

            receive = replay

        query = scope.get("query_string", b"")
        denial = self._policy(method, path, data, query)
        if denial:
            self._deny(denial)
            self._record(method, path, 403, denial, started)
            await _guard_reply(send, 403, denial)
            return

        status: int | None = None
        captured = bytearray()
        overflow = False

        async def observed(message):
            nonlocal status, overflow
            if message["type"] == "http.response.start":
                status = int(message["status"])
            elif message["type"] == "http.response.body":
                chunk = message.get("body", b"")
                room = max(0, MAX_CAPTURE - len(captured))
                if len(chunk) > room:
                    overflow = True
                captured.extend(chunk[:room])
            await send(message)

        try:
            await self.app(scope, receive, observed)
        except BaseException as exc:
            self._fail(getattr(exc, "code", type(exc).__name__))
            raise
        finally:
            self._record(method, path, status, "native_app", started)

        if overflow:
            self._fail("RESPONSE_CAPTURE_OVERFLOW")
            return
        response = _json(bytes(captured))
        if path == "/api/case/open":
            self._complete_case(status, response)
        elif path == "/api/source":
            self._complete_source(status, response)
        else:
            self._complete_read(path, status, response)

    def snapshot(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        with self.lock:
            return list(self.records)

    def evidence(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        with self.lock:
            complete = (
                self.failure_code is None
                and self.source_claimed
                and self.source_complete
                and self.source_png is not None
                and self.case_open_ok >= 1
            )
            return {
                "protocol_complete": complete,
                "failure_code": self.failure_code,
                "source_claimed": self.source_claimed,
                "source_complete": self.source_complete,
                "source_page_png": self.source_png,
                "case_open_attempts": self.case_open_attempts,
                "case_open_ok": self.case_open_ok,
                "auth_denials": self.auth_denials,
                "policy_denials": dict(sorted(self.policy_denials.items())),
                "read_ok": self.read_ok,
            }

    except asyncio.CancelledError:

    except Exception as exc:

            except asyncio.TimeoutError:

                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    task.cancel()
                    try:

                    except BaseException:

    pdf_unchanged = False
    pdf_copy_unchanged = False
    citation_source_unchanged = False

def _host_values(

    port = os.environ.get("LB_PORT")

def _serve_checked(raw_root: str, seconds: int) -> tuple[pathlib.Path, str, str]:
    root = _validate_run_path(raw_root)
    manifest, layout, source, prepared_sha256 = _verify_prepared(root)
    host_port, host_token = _host_values(root, layout)
    _write_json(
        root / "started.json",
        {
            "status": "started",
            "pid": os.getpid(),
            "started_at": datetime.now()
            .astimezone()
            .isoformat(timespec="milliseconds"),
            "root": str(root),
            "appdata": str(layout["appdata"]),
            "requested_seconds": seconds,
            "host_port": host_port,
            "prepared_sha256": prepared_sha256,
        },
    )
    loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
    asyncio.set_event_loop(loop)
    final_path, failure = None, ""
    try:
        name, failure = loop.run_until_complete(
            _serve(
                root,
                layout,
                manifest,
                source,
                prepared_sha256,
                seconds,
                host_port,
                host_token,
            )
        )
        final_path = pathlib.Path(name)
    except BaseException as exc:
        failure = getattr(exc, "code", type(exc).__name__)
        try:
            _write_json(
                root / "run-error.json",
                {
                    "outcome": "FAILED_FOR_ROOT_REVIEW",
                    "exception_type": type(exc).__name__,
                    "guard_code": getattr(exc, "code", None),
                    "root_retained": True,
                },
            )
        except BaseException:
            pass
    finally:
        try:
            loop.run_until_complete(loop.shutdown_asyncgens())
        except BaseException:
            pass
        loop.close()
        asyncio.set_event_loop(None)
    loop_closed = False
    try:
        _write_json(
            root / "loop-closed.json",
            {
                "closed_at": datetime.now()

                .isoformat(timespec="milliseconds"),
                "event_loop_closed": True,

                    final_path is not None and final_path.is_file()

function Invoke-ProcessRelay([string]$SpecPath) {
  $spec = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $SpecPath | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable
  $stdoutLog = [string]$spec.stdoutLog
  $stderrLog = [string]$spec.stderrLog
  $handoffPath = [string]$spec.handoffPath
  foreach ($logPath in @($stdoutLog, $stderrLog, $handoffPath)) {
    $parent = Split-Path -Parent $logPath
    if ($parent -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent -PathType Container)) {
      New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent | Out-Null
    }
  }

  $process = $null
  $stdoutWriter = $null
  $stderrWriter = $null
  try {
    $startInfo = [System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new([string]$spec.processPath)
    $startInfo.UseShellExecute = $false
    $startInfo.WorkingDirectory = [string]$spec.workingDirectory
    $startInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
    $startInfo.RedirectStandardError = $true
    $startInfo.CreateNoWindow = [bool]$spec.createNoWindow
    foreach ($argument in @($spec.arguments)) {
      if ($null -ne $argument) { $startInfo.ArgumentList.Add([string]$argument) }
    }
    $startInfo.Environment.Clear()
    foreach ($entry in $spec.environment.GetEnumerator()) {
      $startInfo.Environment[[string]$entry.Key] = [string]$entry.Value
    }

    $stdoutStream = [IO.File]::Open(
      $stdoutLog,
      [IO.FileMode]::Append,
      [IO.FileAccess]::Write,
      [IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite
    )
    $stderrStream = [IO.File]::Open(
      $stderrLog,
      [IO.FileMode]::Append,
      [IO.FileAccess]::Write,
      [IO.FileShare]::ReadWrite
    )
    $utf8 = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    $stdoutWriter = [IO.StreamWriter]::new($stdoutStream, $utf8)
    $stderrWriter = [IO.StreamWriter]::new($stderrStream, $utf8)
    $stdoutWriter.AutoFlush = $true
    $stderrWriter.AutoFlush = $true

    $process = [System.Diagnostics.Process]::new()
    $process.StartInfo = $startInfo
    if (-not $process.Start()) { throw 'Process.Start returned false' }
    $process.Refresh()
    $record = [ordered]@{
      ok = $true
      pid = $process.Id
      relayPid = $PID
      startTimeUtc = $process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
      startTimeUtcTicks = [string]$process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks
      executablePath = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string]$spec.processPath)
    }
    Write-JsonNoBom $handoffPath $record

    $stdoutTask = $process.StandardOutput.ReadLineAsync()
    $stderrTask = $process.StandardError.ReadLineAsync()
    while ($true) {
      $activity = $false
      if ($null -ne $stdoutTask -and $stdoutTask.IsCompleted) {
        $line = $stdoutTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
        if ($null -eq $line) {
          $stdoutTask = $null
        } else {
          $stdoutWriter.WriteLine((Protect-RelayLogLine -Line $line))
          $stdoutWriter.Flush()
          $stdoutTask = $process.StandardOutput.ReadLineAsync()
        }
        $activity = $true
      }
      if ($null -ne $stderrTask -and $stderrTask.IsCompleted) {
        $line = $stderrTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
        if ($null -eq $line) {
          $stderrTask = $null
        } else {
          $stderrWriter.WriteLine($line)
          $stderrWriter.Flush()
          $stderrTask = $process.StandardError.ReadLineAsync()
        }
        $activity = $true
      }
      if ($process.HasExited -and $null -eq $stdoutTask -and $null -eq $stderrTask) { break }
      if (-not $activity) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 20 }
    }
    $process.WaitForExit()
  } finally {
    if ($stdoutWriter) { $stdoutWriter.Dispose() }
    if ($stderrWriter) { $stderrWriter.Dispose() }
    if ($process) { $process.Dispose() }
  }
}

function Assert-NoReparsePath([string]$Path, [switch]$AllowMissingTail) {
  $full = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
  $driveRoot = [IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($full)
  $current = $driveRoot
  foreach ($segment in (($full.Substring($driveRoot.Length)) -split '[\\/]+')) {
    if (-not $segment) { continue }
    $current = Join-Path $current $segment
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $current)) {
      if ($AllowMissingTail) { continue }
      throw "path component missing: $current"
    }
    $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $current -Force
    if (($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) {
      throw "reparse point refused: $current"
    }
  }
}

function Get-ExactIdentity([int]$TargetPid) {
  $process = Get-Process -Id $TargetPid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  if (-not $process) { return $null }
  try {
    $commandLine = ''
    try {
      $cim = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $TargetPid" -ErrorAction Stop
      if ($cim) { $commandLine = [string]$cim.CommandLine }
    } catch {}
    return [pscustomobject]@{
      pid = $process.Id
      executablePath = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($process.Path)
      startTimeUtcTicks = [string]$process.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks
      commandLine = $commandLine
    }
  } catch {
    return $null
  }
}

function New-IdentityRecord([int]$TargetPid, [string]$Role, [string]$Marker) {
  $identity = Get-ExactIdentity $TargetPid
  if (-not $identity) { throw "cannot record process identity for PID $TargetPid" }
  return [pscustomobject]@{
    pid = $identity.pid
    role = $Role
    executablePath = $identity.executablePath
    startTimeUtcTicks = $identity.startTimeUtcTicks
    marker = $Marker
    recordedAt = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
  }
}

function Test-ExactRecord($Record) {
  $current = Get-ExactIdentity ([int]$Record.pid)
  if (-not $current) { return $false }
  try {
    if ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($current.executablePath) -ine [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string]$Record.executablePath)) {
      return $false
    }
    return (
      [string]$current.startTimeUtcTicks -eq [string]$Record.startTimeUtcTicks -and
      $current.commandLine.IndexOf([string]$Record.marker, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0
    )
  } catch {
    return $false
  }
}

function Add-IdentityRecord($Record) {
  $duplicate = $script:ProcessRecords | Where-Object {
    [int]$_.pid -eq [int]$Record.pid -and
    [string]$_.startTimeUtcTicks -eq [string]$Record.startTimeUtcTicks
  } | Select-Object -First 1
  if (-not $duplicate) {
    $script:ProcessRecords = @($script:ProcessRecords) + @($Record)
  }
}

function New-IsolatedBaseEnvironment {
  $environment = [Collections.Generic.Dictionary[string, string]]::new([StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
  foreach ($name in @(
    'SystemRoot', 'WINDIR', 'SystemDrive', 'PATH', 'PATHEXT', 'COMSPEC',
    'PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE', 'NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS', 'OS',
    'USERNAME', 'USERDOMAIN', 'LOGONSERVER', 'SESSIONNAME'
  )) {
    $value = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($name, [EnvironmentVariableTarget]::Process)
    if ($null -ne $value) { $environment[$name] = $value }
  }
  $environment['HOME'] = $PrivateHome
  $environment['USERPROFILE'] = $PrivateHome
  $environment['HOMEDRIVE'] = [IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($PrivateHome).TrimEnd('\')
  $environment['HOMEPATH'] = $PrivateHome.Substring([IO.Path]::GetPathRoot($PrivateHome).Length - 1)
  $environment['APPDATA'] = $Roaming
  $environment['LOCALAPPDATA'] = $PrivateAppdata
  $environment['HostLB_APPDATA'] = $PrivateAppdata
  $environment['PROGRAMDATA'] = $ProgramData
  $environment['TEMP'] = $PrivateTemp
  $environment['TMP'] = $PrivateTemp
  $environment['TMPDIR'] = $PrivateTemp
  return $environment
}

function Copy-IsolatedEnvironment($SourceEnvironment) {
  $environment = [Collections.Generic.Dictionary[string, string]]::new([StringComparer]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)
  foreach ($entry in $SourceEnvironment.GetEnumerator()) {
    $environment[$entry.Key] = $entry.Value
  }
  return $environment
}

function Start-OwnedTarget(
  [string]$Name,
  [string]$ProcessPath,
  [string[]]$Arguments,
  [string]$WorkingDirectory,
  $Environment,
  [bool]$CreateNoWindow
) {
  $stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmssfff'
  $specPath = Join-Path $StateDir "$Name-relay-$stamp.json"
  $handoffPath = Join-Path $StateDir "$Name-handoff-$stamp.json"
  $spec = [ordered]@{
    processPath = $ProcessPath
    arguments = @($Arguments)
    workingDirectory = $WorkingDirectory
    createNoWindow = $CreateNoWindow
    stdoutLog = Join-Path $LogDir "$Name-$stamp.stdout.log"
    stderrLog = Join-Path $LogDir "$Name-$stamp.stderr.log"
    handoffPath = $handoffPath
    environment = $Environment
  }
  Write-JsonNoBom $specPath $spec
  $relay = Start-Process -FilePath $PwshPath -ArgumentList @(
    '-NoProfile', '-File', $PSCommandPath, '-RunRoot', $rootFull, 
    '-LaunchSpecPath', $specPath
  ) -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru
  $relayRecord = New-IdentityRecord $relay.Id 'relay' $specPath
  Add-IdentityRecord $relayRecord

  $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(15)
  while (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $handoffPath -PathType Leaf)) {
    if ($relay.HasExited) { throw "$Name relay exited before publishing identity" }
    if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) { throw "$Name relay did not publish identity" }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
  }
  $record = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $handoffPath | ConvertFrom-Json
  if (-not $record.ok) { throw "$Name target launch failed" }
  $targetRecord = [pscustomobject]@{
    pid = [int]$record.pid
    role = $Name
    executablePath = [string]$record.executablePath
    startTimeUtcTicks = [string]$record.startTimeUtcTicks
    marker = $(if ($Name -eq 'sidecars') { $SidecarScript } else { $UserData })
    recordedAt = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
  }
  Add-IdentityRecord $targetRecord
  return [pscustomobject]@{
    target = $targetRecord
    relay = $relayRecord
    stdoutLog = $spec.stdoutLog
    stderrLog = $spec.stderrLog
  }
}

function Update-TreeRecords {
  $all = @()
  try { $all = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop) } catch { return }
  $byParent = @{}
  foreach ($entry in $all) {
    $parentPid = [int]$entry.ParentProcessId
    if (-not $byParent.ContainsKey($parentPid)) {
      $byParent[$parentPid] = [Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
    }
    $byParent[$parentPid].Add($entry)
  }
  $queue = [Collections.Generic.Queue[int]]::new()
  $visited = [Collections.Generic.HashSet[int]]::new()
  [void]$queue.Enqueue([int]$script:ElectronPid)
  [void]$queue.Enqueue([int]$script:SidecarsPid)
  $allowedExecutables = @($Electron, $Node, $Python)
  while ($queue.Count -gt 0) {
    $parentPid = $queue.Dequeue()
    if (-not $byParent.ContainsKey($parentPid)) { continue }
    foreach ($child in $byParent[$parentPid]) {
      $childPid = [int]$child.ProcessId
      if (-not $visited.Add($childPid)) { continue }
      [void]$queue.Enqueue($childPid)
      $identity = Get-ExactIdentity $childPid
      if (-not $identity) { continue }
      $allowed = $false
      foreach ($executable in $allowedExecutables) {
        if ($identity.executablePath -ieq $executable) { $allowed = $true; break }
      }
      if (-not $allowed) { continue }
      $marker = $null
      foreach ($candidate in @($rootFull, $Project, $PrimaryRuntime, $NativeEntry, $SidecarScript, $UserData)) {
        if ($identity.commandLine.IndexOf($candidate, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0) {
          $marker = $candidate
          break
        }
      }
      if (-not $marker) { continue }
      $role = if ($identity.commandLine.IndexOf($NativeEntry, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -and
          $identity.commandLine.IndexOf('--serve', [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0) {
        'native-service'
      } elseif ($identity.commandLine.IndexOf('dsh-desktop-host', [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -and
          $identity.commandLine.IndexOf('index.js', [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0) {
        'host'
      } elseif ($identity.executablePath -ieq $Electron) {
        'electron-child'
      } elseif ($identity.executablePath -ieq $Node) {
        'node-child'
      } else {
        'python-helper'
      }
      Add-IdentityRecord ([pscustomobject]@{
        pid = $identity.pid
        role = $role
        executablePath = $identity.executablePath
        startTimeUtcTicks = $identity.startTimeUtcTicks
        marker = $marker
        recordedAt = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
      })
    }
  }

  $startedPath = Join-Path $rootFull 'started.json'
  if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $startedPath -PathType Leaf) {
    try {
      $started = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $startedPath | ConvertFrom-Json
      $nativePid = [int]$started.pid
      if ($nativePid -gt 0) {
        $identity = Get-ExactIdentity $nativePid
        if ($identity -and $identity.executablePath -ieq $Python -and
            $identity.commandLine.IndexOf($NativeEntry, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -and
            $identity.commandLine.IndexOf($rootFull, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0) {
          Add-IdentityRecord ([pscustomobject]@{
            pid = $nativePid
            role = 'native-service'
            executablePath = $identity.executablePath
            startTimeUtcTicks = $identity.startTimeUtcTicks
            marker = $rootFull
            recordedAt = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
          })
          $script:NativePid = $nativePid
        }
      }
      $script:NativePort = [int]$started.host_port
    } catch {}
  }
}

function Stop-ExactRecord($Record) {
  if (-not (Test-ExactRecord $Record)) { return $false }
  Stop-Process -Id ([int]$Record.pid) -Force -ErrorAction Stop
  return $true
}

function Test-PortClosed([int]$Port) {
  if ($Port -le 0) { return [pscustomobject]@{ closed = $false; verified = $false; reason = 'port_not_recorded' } }
  if (-not (Get-Command Get-NetTCPConnection -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    return [pscustomobject]@{ closed = $false; verified = $false; reason = 'Get-NetTCPConnection_unavailable' }
  }
  try {
    $listeners = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $Port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
    return [pscustomobject]@{ closed = ($listeners.Count -eq 0); verified = $true; reason = '' }
  } catch {
    return [pscustomobject]@{ closed = $false; verified = $false; reason = $_.Exception.Message }
  }
}

function Stop-OwnedRun([string]$Reason) {
  Update-TreeRecords
  $rootRecord = $script:ProcessRecords | Where-Object role -eq 'electron' | Select-Object -First 1
  if ($rootRecord -and (Test-ExactRecord $rootRecord)) {
    $process = Get-Process -Id ([int]$rootRecord.pid) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($process) {
      try { [void]$process.CloseMainWindow() } catch {}
      $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(12)
      while (-not $process.HasExited -and (Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
        $process.Refresh()
      }
    }
  }
  Update-TreeRecords
  $stopped = [Collections.Generic.List[int]]::new()
  $pythonForced = $false
  $records = @($script:ProcessRecords | Sort-Object {
    switch ($_.role) {
      'native-service' { 0 }
      'python-helper' { 1 }
      'sidecars' { 2 }
      'node-child' { 3 }
      'host' { 4 }
      'electron-child' { 4 }
      'electron' { 5 }
      'relay' { 6 }
      default { 7 }
    }
  })
  foreach ($record in $records) {
    if ($record.role -eq 'supervisor' -or [int]$record.pid -eq $PID) { continue }
    try {
      if (Stop-ExactRecord $record) {
        $stopped.Add([int]$record.pid)
        if ($record.role -eq 'native-service') { $pythonForced = $true }
      }
    } catch {
      Write-Warning "exact stop refused for PID $($record.pid): $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
  }
  $remaining = @()
  $portCheck = [pscustomobject]@{ closed = $false; verified = $false; reason = 'not_checked' }
  $settleDeadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(10)
  do {
    $remaining = @($script:ProcessRecords | Where-Object {
      $_.role -ne 'supervisor' -and (Test-ExactRecord $_)
    } | ForEach-Object pid)
    $portCheck = Test-PortClosed $script:NativePort
    if ($remaining.Count -eq 0 -and $portCheck.closed) { break }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
  } while ((Get-Date) -lt $settleDeadline)
  $report = [ordered]@{
    stoppedAt = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
    reason = $Reason
    processRecords = @($script:ProcessRecords)
    stoppedPids = @($stopped | Select-Object -Unique)
    remainingPids = $remaining
    nativePort = $script:NativePort
    portClosed = [bool]$portCheck.closed
    portVerificationAvailable = [bool]$portCheck.verified
    portVerificationError = [string]$portCheck.reason
    pythonForcedStop = $pythonForced
    pythonCleanupClaimed = $false
  }
  Write-JsonNoBom $StopReportPath $report
  return ($remaining.Count -eq 0 -and $portCheck.closed)
}

function Invoke-OwnedSupervisor {
  $script:ProcessRecords = @()
  $script:StartedAt = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
  $script:DeadlineUtc = ((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime()).AddSeconds($LifetimeSeconds).ToString('o')
  $script:ElectronPid = 0
  $script:SidecarsPid = 0
  $script:NativePid = 0
  $script:NativePort = 0
  $lockStream = $null
  $electronLaunch = $null
  $sidecarLaunch = $null
  $terminationReason = 'unknown'
  try {
    Assert-Preflight
    Prepare-PrivateProfile
    $lockPath = Join-Path $StateDir 'run.lock'
    $lockStream = [IO.File]::Open($lockPath, [IO.FileMode]::CreateNew, [IO.FileAccess]::ReadWrite, [IO.FileShare]::None)
    $supervisorIdentity = Get-ExactIdentity $PID
    if (-not $supervisorIdentity) { throw 'cannot record supervisor identity' }
    $script:SupervisorRecord = [pscustomobject]@{
      pid = $supervisorIdentity.pid
      role = 'supervisor'
      executablePath = $supervisorIdentity.executablePath
      startTimeUtcTicks = $supervisorIdentity.startTimeUtcTicks
      marker = $rootFull
      recordedAt = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
    }
    Write-RunState 'prepared'

    $baseEnvironment = New-IsolatedBaseEnvironment
    $sidecarEnvironment = Copy-IsolatedEnvironment $baseEnvironment
    $sidecarEnvironment['T50_FAKE_SEARCH_TOKEN'] = 'T50_FAKE_SEARCH_TOKEN_NOT_A_SECRET'
    $sidecarEnvironment['T50_FAKE_LAWFIRM_TOKEN'] = 'T50_FAKE_LAWFIRM_TOKEN_NOT_A_SECRET'
    $sidecarState = Join-Path $LogDir 'fake-sidecars.json'
    $sidecarLaunch = Start-OwnedTarget `
      -Name 'sidecars' `
      -ProcessPath $Node `
      -Arguments @($SidecarScript, '--state-file', $sidecarState, '--reply-file', $ReplyFixture) `
      -WorkingDirectory $E50Runtime `
      -Environment $sidecarEnvironment `
      -CreateNoWindow $true
    $script:SidecarsPid = [int]$sidecarLaunch.target.pid

    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(12)
    while (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $sidecarState -PathType Leaf)) {
      if (-not (Test-ExactRecord $sidecarLaunch.target)) { throw 'fake sidecars exited before publishing loopback ports' }
      if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) { throw 'fake sidecars did not publish loopback ports' }
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
    }
    $ports = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $sidecarState | ConvertFrom-Json
    foreach ($port in @([int]$ports.modelPort, [int]$ports.searchPort)) {
      if ($port -lt 1 -or $port -gt 65535) { throw "invalid fake sidecar port: $port" }
    }

    $electronEnvironment = Copy-IsolatedEnvironment $baseEnvironment
    $electronEnvironment['DSH_HOME'] = $DshHome
    $electronEnvironment['DSH_DESKTOP_DSH_DIR'] = $Project
    $electronEnvironment['DSH_DESKTOP_USER_DATA_DIR'] = $UserData
    $electronEnvironment['DSH_DESKTOP_PRIMARY_RUNTIME_DIR'] = $PrimaryRuntime
    $electronEnvironment['DSH_DESKTOP_OPEN_DEVTOOLS'] = '0'
    $electronEnvironment['DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED'] = '1'
    $electronEnvironment['DSH_TELEMETRY_MODE'] = 'DISABLED'
    $electronEnvironment['DSH_DESKTOP_UPDATE_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS'] = '2147483647'
    $electronEnvironment['DSH_DESKTOP_UPDATE_CHECK_MAX_BACKOFF_MS'] = '2147483647'
    $electronEnvironment['DSH_DESKTOP_UPDATE_CHECK_JITTER'] = '0'
    $electronEnvironment['LAWBENCH_HOST_PORT'] = '0'
    $electronEnvironment['LAWBENCH_SKILLS_DIR'] = $HostSkills
    $electronEnvironment['LAWBENCH_SKILL_DIRS'] = ConvertTo-Json -Compress -InputObject @($HostSkills)
    $electronEnvironment['LAWBENCH_SERVICE_CWD'] = $ServiceRoot
    $electronEnvironment['LAWBENCH_SERVICE_CMD'] = ConvertTo-Json -Compress -InputObject @(
      $Python, '-B', '-X', 'utf8', $NativeEntry, '--serve', '--root', $rootFull, '--seconds', [string]$LifetimeSeconds
    )
    $electronEnvironment['LAWBENCH_SERVICE_ENV'] = '{}'
    $electronEnvironment['T50_LLM_PORT'] = [string]$ports.modelPort
    $electronEnvironment['T50_FAKE_SEARCH_PORT'] = [string]$ports.searchPort
    $electronEnvironment['T50_FAKE_SEARCH_TOKEN'] = 'T50_FAKE_SEARCH_TOKEN_NOT_A_SECRET'
    $electronEnvironment['T50_FAKE_LAWFIRM_TOKEN'] = 'T50_FAKE_LAWFIRM_TOKEN_NOT_A_SECRET'
    $electronEnvironment['T50_GUARD_READY_FILE'] = Join-Path $LogDir 'guard-ready.log'
    $electronEnvironment['T50_NETWORK_DENIAL_LOG'] = Join-Path $LogDir 'network-denied.log'
    $resolverUrl = ([Uri]$Resolver).AbsoluteUri
    $electronEnvironment['NODE_OPTIONS'] = "--import=$resolverUrl --require=$Guard"
    $electronEnvironment['HTTP_PROXY'] = 'http://127.0.0.1:9'
    $electronEnvironment['HTTPS_PROXY'] = 'http://127.0.0.1:9'
    $electronEnvironment['ALL_PROXY'] = 'http://127.0.0.1:9'
    $electronEnvironment['NO_PROXY'] = '127.0.0.1,localhost,::1'
    $electronEnvironment['ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING'] = '1'

    $electronArguments = @(
      '--proxy-server=http://127.0.0.1:9',
      '--proxy-bypass-list=127.0.0.1;localhost',
      "--user-data-dir=$UserData",
      $DesktopRoot
    )
    $electronLaunch = Start-OwnedTarget `
      -Name 'electron' `
      -ProcessPath $Electron `
      -Arguments $electronArguments `
      -WorkingDirectory $DesktopRoot `
      -Environment $electronEnvironment `
      -CreateNoWindow $false
    $script:ElectronPid = [int]$electronLaunch.target.pid
    $script:DeadlineUtc = ((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime()).AddSeconds($LifetimeSeconds).ToString('o')
    Write-RunState 'launching'

    $readyPath = Join-Path $rootFull 'ready.json'
    $startedPath = Join-Path $rootFull 'started.json'
    $readyDeadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(45)
    while (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $readyPath -PathType Leaf)) {
      Update-TreeRecords
      Write-RunState 'launching'
      if (-not (Test-ExactRecord $electronLaunch.target)) {
        throw 'Electron exited before the native service published ready.json'
      }
      if ((Get-Date) -gt $readyDeadline) {
        throw 'native service did not publish ready.json within 45 seconds'
      }
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
    }
    Update-TreeRecords
    if ($script:NativePid -le 0 -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $startedPath -PathType Leaf)) {
      throw 'native service started.json/PID identity is incomplete'
    }
    if ($script:NativePort -lt 1 -or $script:NativePort -gt 65535) {
      throw 'native service assigned port is not recorded'
    }
    Write-RunState 'running'
    Write-JsonNoBom $HandoffPath ([ordered]@{
      ok = $true
      runRoot = $rootFull
      state = $StatePath
      rootPid = $script:ElectronPid
      nativePid = $script:NativePid
      nativePort = $script:NativePort
      deadlineUtc = $script:DeadlineUtc
      stopScript = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'stop.ps1'
    })

    $lastDiscovery = Get-Date
    while ($true) {
      if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $StopRequestPath -PathType Leaf) {
        $terminationReason = 'requested'
        break
      }
      if (-not (Test-ExactRecord $electronLaunch.target)) {
        $terminationReason = 'root-exited'
        break
      }
      if ((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime() -ge [datetime]::Parse($script:DeadlineUtc).ToUniversalTime()) {
        $terminationReason = 'outer-budget'
        break
      }
      if (((Get-Date) - $lastDiscovery).TotalMilliseconds -ge 750) {
        Update-TreeRecords
        Write-RunState 'running'
        $lastDiscovery = Get-Date
      }
      Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250
    }
    $clean = Stop-OwnedRun $terminationReason
    Write-RunState $(if ($clean) { 'stopped' } else { 'stop-incomplete' }) $terminationReason
    if (-not $clean) { return 1 }
    return 0
  } catch {
    $terminationReason = 'exception'
    try {
      if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $StateDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $StateDir | Out-Null }
      Write-JsonNoBom $LaunchErrorPath ([ordered]@{
        at = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
        error = $_.Exception.Message
        runRoot = $rootFull
        rootRetained = $true
      })
    } catch {}
    try {
      if ($electronLaunch -or $sidecarLaunch -or $ProcessRecords.Count -gt 0) { [void](Stop-OwnedRun $terminationReason) }
    } catch {}
    try { Write-RunState 'failed' $terminationReason } catch {}
    return 1
  } finally {
    if ($lockStream) { $lockStream.Dispose() }
  }
}

if ($OwnedSupervisor) {
  $code = Invoke-OwnedSupervisor
  exit $code
}
